resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and Talking Trail give 1936; a Flickr photo caption gives 1935. The story uses 1936 and reports the caption's date as a disagreement.
NHLR places the tower in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest; firelookout.com and the Montana Forest Lookouts page say Custer National Forest. The story names both without choosing.
NHLR gives 4,125 ft (1,257 m); firelookout.com gives 4,220 ft. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Agency, height, registration and standing status agree across sources. History is thin: Talking Trail is a general video-page summary, and the Flickr item is a single photo caption, so the 1935 date is weaker than 1936. Brief's access 'unknown' kept; no source gives public access, climbing or rental status, so no access level is set. Staffing as_of is the NHLR registration date, used as a proxy because the 'not used in several decades' wording is undated. Talking Trail's general remarks about Montana towers being rented out were not applied to this tower. No photos added (no image URLs captured). Not verified: whether the cabin still exists and the tower's current condition.
